metadata.title: On the causality of gravitational pp-wave spacetimes: A null version of Anderson's rigidity theorem
metadata.abstract: We prove that plane waves are the only gravitational pp-wave spacetimes which are distinguishing; in particular, they are the only strongly causal ones. This is used to prove a null version of Anderson's rigidity theorem, conjectured by Costa e Silva and Flores: every geodesically complete, transversally complete, strongly causal, Ricci-flat Brinkmann spacetime of dimension $4$ is isometric to a quotient of a plane wave spacetime.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: pp-wave 因果性与零方向刚性
analysis.workSummary: 在四维 gravitational pp-wave、H 对横向变量 harmonic 的框架中，证明非 plane wave 同时失去 future/past distinguishing。用 transverse excursion 的方向 Fourier 展开处理随 u 变化的 H；再借完整 Brinkmann 的 universal-cover 识别，得到 geodesically complete、transversally complete、strongly causal、Ricci-flat 时空为 plane-wave 商。
analysis.breakthrough: 解决 Costa e Silva–Flores 的 Anderson 零方向刚性猜想。
analysis.limitations: pp-wave 的因果分类不需完整性；Brinkmann 商分类需两种完整性和强因果。Ehlers–Kundt 猜想的反例与本结论相容，不能把 geodesic completeness 单独作为 plane-wave 判据。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者声明所有想法出自人类；Claude Fable 5.1 与 Claude Sonnet 5 用于制图、证明检查、文献检索、编辑和部分写作。
